To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the NAMUR standard MTP is a suitable approach to represent modular process automation systems.
the OPC UA server is a suitable platform for the representation and online discovery of modules.
we have successfully developed an OPC UA based MTP representation that allows for the discovery and configuration of process modules in an online environment.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a semantic model for the description of modules in OPC UA, the implementation of this model and a prototype for the discovery of MTPs.
the development of an approach for the transformation of MTPs into OPC UA to enable plug and produce for process automation.
the following research questions: 1) Which OPC UA information model can be used to represent MTPs and which information model extensions are needed?
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
a transformation of the NAMUM MTP into an OPC UA server is feasible.
OPC UA is a good candidate for the communication between process modules and process control system and that the presented approach for the representation is suitable.
the OPC UA approach is a promising solution for the online discovery of modules.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
OPC UA can be used to represent MTPs in an efficient way, and that the resulting information model is suitable for online discovery of process automation modules.
we are able to show that it is feasible to represent MTP files as OPC UA information models, and that the OPC UA information model can be used for discovery and configuration of process modules.
OPC UA is a promising candidate for the integration of modules in process automation systems.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the MTP can be mapped to OPC UA in a way that the MTP structure and the OPC UA address space structure are aligned.
the OPC UA information model can be used for representing MTPs.
the MTP can be transformed to OPC UA without losing its semantics.
